title: Gold breakout T1 sized by the Gold Macro Score
verdict: FAIL: H1 (longs above +0.25 better) fails, difference +0.149R (t +1.93); H2 (shorts above +0.25 worse) fails, difference −0.067R (t −0.88)
deviation: The plan named `GGO_TO=2026-11-13` for the candle download. The loader drops the last calendar day of a file, so candles ending at midnight on 13 Nov left 12 Nov out and the gate missed by one trade (3,712 against 3,713). The candles of 12-13 Nov were added (a second download, `GGO_FROM=2026-11-12`, merged by time) so that the plan's own window, days to 2026-11-12, and its gate hold. No trade was looked at before the gate passed.
reading: Longs taken with the score above +0.25 did better (+0.268R against +0.119R a trade, positive in both halves), but by a margin the test cannot separate from luck (t +1.93, Holm p 0.054); counted by calendar months it is nil (t −0.07). Shorts above +0.25 were not worse in a way that counts (t −0.88). Sized the book's way, T1 earns +0.155R per unit of risk against +0.140R flat, with the same month t and drawdown: no reason to size T1 by the score. T1's forward record stays flat 1R.
